text:
marco-cust: Hey team — onboarding run hit a problem. Our front-end spawns ~200 parallel SDK init calls during feature rollout and we see a mix of 401s and 429s on preflight. Example log snippet:

marco-cust: "[2026-03-17T14:05:02Z] init error: 401 handshake failed
[2026-03-17T14:05:02Z] preflight: 429 Too Many Requests - X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0"

marco-cust: Any quick mitigations? We're mid-rollout and it's affecting signups.

casey-cs: Oof — thanks for flagging. Two quick Qs: SDK version and are you minting ephemeral tokens per client or using a shared key?

marco-cust: Using node sdk v1.4.2 and our auth server mints ephemeral tokens per session. We do parallel token fetches then immediate SDK init.

alice-sdk: Classic stampede pattern. Quick wins: reduce concurrency on init, add jittered splay on token fetch, and reuse preflight where possible. Also enable keepalive so the gateway reuses connections. Sample client-side debounce: 

alice-sdk: ```js
// pseudocode
const MAX_SIMULTANEOUS_INIT = 12;
const splay = () => Math.random() * 3000; // 0-3s jitter
await sleep(splay());
await initSdk({ token });
```

tina-sre: From infra logs we saw a 30s window with 10k preflight requests for your account — we can temporarily raise the burst allowance and add a small grace TTL on preflight checks for onboarding traffic. Meanwhile please make sure clients honor Retry-After and exponential backoff.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Temporarily increased burst allowance for acct-redwood-123 by +50 req/s until 2026-03-30T02:00Z. Audit: #INC-2026-0341 :rocket:

casey-cs: Also check token clock skew - if many clients have drifted clocks they re-request tokens frequently. Another client-side knob: limit initial parallelism in the SDK by setting env MAX_INIT_CONCURRENT or use the provided init queue: https://redwood.ai/docs/onboard-preflight

marco-cust: Ok applied the splay + limited concurrency to 12, added Retry-After handling. New logs after 10 minutes:

marco-cust: "[2026-03-17T14:12:09Z] init ok 200 token-exchange
[2026-03-17T14:12:09Z] preflight ok 200 X-RateLimit-Remaining: 47
[2026-03-17T14:12:10Z] occasional 429s (~0.8% of inits) - far better than before"

alice-sdk: Nice — if you can flip on SDK init coalescing it will collapse concurrent preflights into a single backend call: 

alice-sdk: ```json
{"init": {"coalesce": true, "maxConcurrent": 12, "backoff":{"baseMs":200, "factor":2}}}
```

casey-cs: I'll capture these steps into an onboarding playbook and share follow-up items (postmortem + suggested client flags). Want me to tag engineering for an SDK helper function to make splay automatic?

marco-cust: Please do. Huge help — rolling the fix to the rest of users now. Thanks :+1: :heart:

tina-sre: Marking ticket as mitigated. We'll revert the burst allowance after the campaign and follow up with a short runbook for new customers doing parallel warmups.

casey-cs: Follow-up action: create /docs/internal/onboarding-concurrency-playbook and add sample snippets + recommended defaults. I'll ping when done.

marco-cust: Perfect — would love a short blurb we can include in our internal rollout checklist.

casey-cs: Will do. Closing this thread once doc is up. Thanks! :rocket:
